architecture.editorial_thesis: In 2026-W36 frontier capability turned governable-and-checkable — OpenAI shipped its first Critical-cyber model under broad monitoring while admitting weaker monitorability, Anthropic closed the largest computer-checked proof in Lean with a replayable artifact, and NVIDIA agreed to acquire Hugging Face while pledging to preserve its open, compute-agnostic character — while open efficient fleets, frontier coding releases, agent harnesses, and spatial/video productization filled out a dense, source-bounded week.
architecture_goals: Center the Critical-cyber flagship with its monitorability caveat without overstating vendor evals
Present the Fermat formalization as verification with a checkable artifact, not a new proof idea
Ground the $12.93B platform acquisition in announced-pledge bounds
Show open efficient releases with license/date precision
Pair frontier coding claims with their methodology silence
Advance the agent harness plane with GA/preview discipline
Place spatial/video productization with leaderboard-date bounds
